tei:div.tei:p: 419) ༄༅/ kyai/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i tog /ston mchog mi yi seng ge'i rgyal ba'i bstan// bsil ldan rwa ba dkar po'i ljongs 'di ru// 'dren mdzad mkhan slob chos rgyal mes dbon gsum// rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i shing rta che// snga 'gyur ba zhes srid pa'i khong na snyan// mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod grub pa'i mngon rtogs kyis// 'phags yul 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug dang*// grub chen bcu phrag brgyad dang 'gran bzod pa'i// so zur gnubs dang dam gtsang byams gsum dang*// chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams sogs// mdo sgyu sems gsum brgyud pa rin po che'i// bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin la zla bral ba// rig pa 'dzin pa thugs mchog drag rtsal gyi// bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i yul bdag rnams// bsang mchod mgron du yid ltar mgyogs pa'i bang*// glog ltar g.yo bas gshegs nas rang rang dang*// 'tsham pa'i stan la bag phob sngon byon gyi// rgyal ba'i tha tshig khog nas dran par mdzod*// bzang shing zhugs la sbar ba'i dud sprin las// dgyes rgu'i 420) mchod sprin nam mkha'i mthar khyab pas// yul skyong dgra lha'i rgyal po mchog rnams bsang*// rdo gnyan smad bu rdo rje drag rtsal bsang*// sa sdom rdo rje legs pa'i btsan rgod bsang*// rdo kho rdo rje khyung chen drag rtsal bsang*// sman ti rdo rje dpal ldan brtsegs pa bsang*// rdzing ra rdo rje dbang chen btsan rgod bsang*// ba nye bkra shis g.yu yi rtsa lha bsang*// se tho phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba bsang*// dmar 'gu btsan rgod rdo rje dmar po bsang*// ra nu rgyal ba don kun grub pa bsang*// 'brug rgyal ser mo 'bum gyis bskor ba bsang*// dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje 'bar ba bsang*// yul lha chen po gtsug ra gtsug phrom bsang*// go bo rdo rje bgegs dpung kun 'joms bsang*/

khra ze rdo rje ri dbang bkra shis bsang*// nag 'dzo brag skas chos skyong dngos rgyugs bsang*// dong ti rdo rje bdud dpung kun 'joms bsang*// dpal 'dzoms rdo rje dgra bgegs kun 'dul bsang*// g.yag thod bkra shis gter gyi bum pa bsang*// zhe khyim phyogs bzhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal bsang*// gyang skye bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsang*/ 421) /rag nyag bkra shis legs pa'i blo gros bsang*// shel dkar rdo rje blo gros bzang po bsang*// ma chen sku lha gsang ba'i yum chen bsang*// sang yag rdo rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bsang*/ khro 'bar btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun bsang*// rag phram rdo rje khyung chen drag po bsang*// gnyan chen btsan rgod drag po 'bu rong bsang*// lha btsan rgyal ba dkar mdzangs gnyan po bsang*// kam ri dkar mo ri bkra 'bum sde bsang*// dbu rtse rdo rje khyung rgod drag po bsang*// 'ug mgo rdo rje 'bar ba'i spyan ldan bsang*// tshe dpal rgyal ba 'dod don sgrub byed bsang*// ye rang rdo rje legs pa'i blo gros bsang*// btsun mo klu mo bye ba 'bum sde bsang*// dmu sde rdzong chen bdud btsan klu yi ging*// sras dang blon po bka' 'khor bcas pa bsang*// sdom brag la sogs pho nya phyag brnyan bsang*// dgyes pa'i gzi mdangs yar zla'i dpal ltar bskyed// rngams pa'i drag shul sa gsum g.yo ba yis// gzugs can gzugs med char bkag gdug can gyi*// rig sngags nus pa dmod pa'i stobs kyis shigs// glo snying dron mo sbar gyis thob la zo// ma rung ltas ngan sna dgu myur du 422)thongs// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad kyis gzir dang bcas// lus sems kha sbyor da lta nyid du phyes// lha mi'i gnas kun rab tu khyab pa yi// char sprin mthon mthing nor bu'i lhun po la// mdzes pa'i glog zhags dmar po'i ska rags can// dbyar rnga rab tu gzhon nu'i glu dang bcas// bde legs sa gsum khyab pa'i char gyi rgyun// 'dzad med 'dod rgu'i gter chen da lta snyil// chil chil snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang bcas par// zim zim bdud rtsi'i bcud chen so la phobs/

mdzes mdzes sum rtsen sa la 'phos pa lta'i// smin smin lo tog sman ljongs rab tu rgyas// bkra shis snod kyi dge mtshan g.yang du 'khyil// bkra shis bcud kyi dpal 'byor gong du 'phel// bkra shis rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i snang ba rgyas// bkra shis bde skyid dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas mdzod/
lcags rta zla bzhi tshes brgyad la padma ma ṇis so// dge'o//
